say:2:1221115001:1.text: Lucky us! No one saw us leaving the bottle!
say:2:1221115001:1.source_cn: 运气真好，没人看到是我们放的漂流瓶！

say:3:1221115002:1.text: What's next? We wait for Almer to notice it when he goes out?
say:3:1221115002:1.source_cn: 接下来要怎么办？等安尔姆出门的时候发现吗？

say:4:1221115003:1.text: Don't worry! Chippy already has a plan!
